name: Muse Space — muse空间
description_en: 48 ready-to-use mini-app templates for Muse Spaces.
description_zh: 48 个开箱即用的 Muse Space 小程序模板。

templates.description_en: Save, organize and reuse your best prompts. One tap to copy.
templates.description_zh: 收藏、分类、复用提示词，一键复制。

templates.description_en: Turn rough notes into decisions, actions and owners.
templates.description_zh: 纪要结构化：决议、待办、负责人。

templates.description_en: Polish resume bullets and check fit against a target role.
templates.description_zh: 简历要点打磨与岗位匹配清单。

templates.description_en: Plan topics, schedule posts and track publish status in one view.
templates.description_zh: 选题、排期、发布状态一屏管。

templates.description_en: A Pomodoro timer with a 7-day focus history and long breaks.
templates.description_zh: 番茄钟加近 7 天专注记录与长休。

templates.description_en: Track streaks, 7-day check-ins and completion rates.
templates.description_zh: 习惯连续天数、近 7 天打卡与完成率。

templates.description_en: A three-column board with drag, priority and due dates.
templates.description_zh: 三列看板、拖拽、优先级。

templates.description_en: Recurring to-dos with due dates that reset when done.
templates.description_zh: 周期待办，到期提醒，做完自动顺延。

templates.description_en: Set a monthly budget, cap each category, see what is left.
templates.description_zh: 月预算、分类上限、剩余一目了然。

templates.description_en: Log an expense in seconds and see category totals.
templates.description_zh: 快速记一笔、分类汇总。

templates.description_en: List every subscription, renewal date, yearly cost and what's due in 30 days.
templates.description_zh: 订阅清单、续费日期、年支出与 30 天内续费。

templates.description_en: Track progress and milestones for each savings goal.
templates.description_zh: 目标进度、里程碑。

templates.description_en: Log exercises, sets, reps and weight — with streaks and a daily coach tip.
templates.description_zh: 动作、组数、重量记录，附连续打卡与教练提示。

templates.description_en: Track calories and protein for every meal, with an editable daily goal and a 7-day history.
templates.description_zh: 记录每餐的热量与蛋白质，可改每日目标，并看最近 7 天的热量变化。

templates.description_en: Log sleep hours and mood, see the curve over time.
templates.description_zh: 睡眠时长、心情曲线。

templates.description_en: Turn a timetable into review blocks and track progress.
templates.description_zh: 课表转复习块、进度跟踪。

templates.description_en: Spaced repetition flashcards with mastery levels, weakest-first review and per-level counts.
templates.description_zh: 间隔重复、掌握度，先练最弱卡片，按等级统计。

templates.description_en: Track your book list, progress and highlights.
templates.description_zh: 书单、进度、摘录。

templates.description_en: A timed quiz game across five categories — 50 questions — with score, streaks and a review.
templates.description_zh: 五分类限时问答共 50 题：计分、连胜，答完还能复盘错题。

templates.description_en: Plan day-by-day itineraries, checklists and trip budget.
templates.description_zh: 行程天表、清单、预算。

templates.description_en: Plan a week of meals and get the grocery list automatically.
templates.description_zh: 一周食谱自动带出买菜清单。

templates.description_en: Track stock, expiry dates and who does which chore.
templates.description_zh: 库存、保质期、家务分工。

templates.description_en: Gift ideas, sizes and budgets, sorted by person.
templates.description_zh: 按人记礼物点子、尺码与预算。

templates.description_en: Track every win, loss and rivalry across game nights.
templates.description_zh: 每局胜负与对手战绩都记下来。

templates.description_en: Walks, meals and naps — your pet's whole day in one place.
templates.description_zh: 遛弯、吃饭、午睡，宠物的一天都在这。

templates.description_en: Every restaurant you saved and never went to, with prices and ratings.
templates.description_zh: 收藏了却没去过的店，价格评分都记着。

templates.description_en: Every bill, its due date and the best card to pay with.
templates.description_zh: 账单、到期日与刷哪张卡。

templates.description_en: Holdings, total value, gain/loss and allocation against your targets — prices entered by hand.
templates.description_zh: 持仓、总资产、盈亏与目标配置对比，价格手动填写。

templates.description_en: Catch an idea in seconds, sort it later.
templates.description_zh: 灵感随手记，稍后再归类。

templates.description_en: A Palm-style organizer: datebook, to-dos, memos and contacts in one device.
templates.description_zh: 掌上电脑风整理器：日程、待办、备忘与通讯录合一。

templates.description_en: Your pinned apps and links in one hub — search, pin and open in one tap.
templates.description_zh: 常用应用与链接收进一个中心，搜、钉、点开一步到位。

templates.description_en: Plan the week as time blocks: work, study, health and rest, with hours per category.
templates.description_zh: 按周排时间块：工作、学习、健康与休息，各类时长一目了然。

templates.description_en: Today at a glance: agenda, top tasks, email triage and the news that matters.
templates.description_zh: 今天一眼看完：日程、要事、邮件分拣与值得看的新闻。

templates.description_en: Every trip pinned with its story.
templates.description_zh: 每次旅行钉上地点与故事。

templates.description_en: Days left to every event that matters.
templates.description_zh: 重要日子还剩几天，一眼看到。

templates.description_en: Food stock, quantities and expiry dates — with low-stock and expiring-soon alerts and a restock list.
templates.description_zh: 食材库存、数量与保质期，快过期与缺货都提醒，另有待采购清单。

templates.description_en: A playable Sudoku with three difficulties, a daily challenge, notes, hints, a timer and best times.
templates.description_zh: 能玩的数独：三档难度、每日一题、笔记、提示、计时与最佳成绩。

templates.description_en: A price watchlist: target prices, discounts and a buy-now badge when a logged price hits target — with categories, expiry dates and a verified flag.
templates.description_zh: 价格关注清单：目标价、折扣，记录的价格降到目标价就亮下手标记；可按分类筛选，带截止日期与核实标记。

templates.description_en: The whole family's week in one place: who does what, when, and who handles each pickup.
templates.description_zh: 全家一周日程放一处：谁、何时、做什么，谁负责接送，一眼看清。

templates.description_en: Log your weight daily, set a goal weight and watch the trend line move.
templates.description_zh: 每天记录体重，设定目标体重，看趋势线慢慢移动。

templates.description_en: Every game you follow on one wall, with a scrolling score ticker.
templates.description_zh: 关注的比赛全在一面墙上，附滚动比分条。

templates.description_en: Move each piece from idea to draft, editing, scheduled and published.
templates.description_zh: 每条内容从点子到草稿、编辑、排期、发布，一步步往前推。

templates.description_en: Type a topic and get a full Muse Space build prompt, ready to paste.
templates.description_zh: 输入一个赛道，得到一条能直接建 Space 的完整提示词。

templates.description_en: Pick a pose from the library and get a paste-ready prompt in four formats.
templates.description_zh: 从姿势库里点一个姿势，四种格式提示词直接复制。

templates.description_en: Plan a short video: shot list, per-model prompts and a delivery checklist.
templates.description_zh: 排一部短视频：分镜表、各模型提示词与成片任务单。

templates.description_en: Track AI free credits and trials with expiry countdowns — manually verified, expired offers archived.
templates.description_zh: 盯住各家 AI 免费额度与试用：到期倒计时、手动核实，过期自动归档。

templates.description_en: Paste a proxy subscription, convert it across seven client formats — with dedupe, batch rename and a health check.
templates.description_zh: 粘贴梯子订阅，一键转成 Clash、sing-box 等七种格式，去重、批量重命名、订阅体检。

templates.description_en: Plan a holiday feast: guests and diets, menu by course, prep timeline and shopping list.
templates.description_zh: 节日大餐指挥中心：宾客与忌口、分菜式菜单、备菜时间线与采购清单。
